dataset: AER practical exercise - synthetic challenge intake records
note: Entirely fabricated. All entities and identifiers are fictional. These four examiner-style records cover ambiguity, sensitive information, adversarial/injection text, non-English content, and tone/negation traps. Additional malformed-input checks live in data/crash_test_*.json and are safe to run because ingest normalizes their shapes.

records.raw_text: CALLER: there was a hiss and then a rotten-egg smell by the playground maybe ten minutes ago. Two kids were coughing, but the wind shifted and I can't smell it now. AGENT: which facility? CALLER: the blue tanks east of the creek, I think the trucks say Northstar, or Northland. My neighbour already called from 587-555-0186. AGENT: exact location? CALLER: Willow Bend school, or Willow Brook... the small school off Township 466. [call disconnected]
